metadata.title: Powers of projective lines inside full flag varieties
metadata.abstract: Up to now, symplectic foliations of Poisson varieties have been primarily studied from a set theoretic perspective by describing their symplectic leaves individually as orbit closures. In the direction of obtaining algebro-geometric characterizations, for the standard Poisson structure $\pi$ on the full flag variety $G/B_+$ of a complex semisimple algebraic group $G$, we prove that the irreducible components of the reduced part of the 0-degeneracy locus of $(G/B_+, \pi)$ are precisely the inclusion-maximal $T$-stable complete Poisson submanifolds of $(G/B_+, \pi)$ that are isomorphic to powers of $\mathbb{P}^1$. This characterization is based on a theorem that explicitly classifies the closed Richardson varieties of $G/B_+$ isomorphic to $(\mathbb{P}^1)^d$. In turn, this theorem is based on a general theorem for arbitrary $T$-stable subvarieties of full flag varieties $G/B_+$ isomorphic to $(\mathbb{P}^1)^d$.
